{N} can put armed citizens on their own ground, which counts for something against a disorganized raid and for nothing at all against a disciplined force.

{N} has been short of money for years, and each lean season leaves less to spend when a real crisis comes. The tally of preserved food at {N} is falling, because the trades that salt and dry it are failing; if the {T} were cut off, it would run short quickly.
The {T} settles things itself, quickly, and does not always settle them well.
If you are wronged at {N}, there is nowhere to take it, and no local is surprised.
{N} has no line and no force, and the threat now at hand has noticed both.
